# Musicians' Hearing Services

> > Specialized audiology and hearing care for musicians, offering custom hearing aids, in-ear monitors, tinnitus treatment, and hearing protection on Harley Street.

Musicians' Hearing Services is a dedicated audiological practice with 25 years of experience serving musicians and audio professionals. Based on Harley Street in London, they provide specialized hearing solutions tailored to the unique needs of musicians, including custom IEMs from leading manufacturers, musician-specific hearing aids, and comprehensive hearing protection.

## Key Topics

- hearing aids for musicians
- in-ear monitors (IEMs)
- custom hearing protection
- tinnitus treatment
- audiological assessment
- ear wax removal
- Musicians' Hearing Health Scheme
- ACS
- Ultimate Ears
- JH Audio
- 64 Audio
- Puretone
- Harley Street
- custom ear plugs
- sound isolation

## Core Services

- [Home - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk): Musicians' Hearing Services homepage: 25 years serving musicians with hearing aids, IEMs, and protection.

- [Musicians' Hearing Health Scheme - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/musicians-hearing-health-scheme): Affordable hearing assessments and protection scheme for UK musicians.

## Hearing Aids & Audiological Services

- [Hearing Aids For Musicians - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-aids-musicians): Specialized hearing aids for musicians with music frequency optimization.
- [Hearing Issues - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-issues): Audiological assessment and treatment for musician hearing issues.
- [Tinnitus Treatment - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/tinnitus-treatment): Tinnitus treatment and hearing therapy services for musicians.
- [Ear Wax Removal - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/ear-wax-removal): Fast ear wax removal via microsuction or irrigation on Harley Street.

## In-Ear Monitors

- [In-Ear Monitors - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors): Custom in-ear monitor impressions and IEM supply services.
- [ACS - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors/acs-in-ear-monitors): ACS custom in-ear monitors through recommended UK audiologists.
- [Ultimate Ears - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors/ultimate-ears): Ultimate Ears custom IEM impressions and services.
- [JH Audio - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors/jh-audio): Authorized JH Audio in-ear monitor impressions and services.
- [64 Audio - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors/64-audio): Authorized 64 Audio in-ear monitor impressions and services.
- [Puretone - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/in-ear-monitors/puretone): Authorized Puretone custom IEM impressions and services.

## Hearing Protection Solutions

- [Hearing Protection - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection): Custom hearing protection for musicians and occupational noise exposure.
- [Musicians' Ear Plugs - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/musicians-ear-plugs): Custom ACS musician ear plugs for hearing protection.
- [Custom Headphones - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection/custom-headphones): Custom molded headphones with noise reduction for musicians.
- [Noise Cancelling Earplugs - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection/noise-cancelling-earplugs): Biopact noise-cancelling earplugs for industrial and music safety.

## Specialized Applications

- [TV Presenter Fittings - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection/tv-presenter-fittings): Custom earmoulds for TV presenters to hear discreet instructions.
- [Sleeping Ear Plugs - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection/sleeping-ear-plugs): Custom sleeping ear plugs for noise blocking and sleep comfort.
- [Motorcycle Ear Plugs - Musicians' Hearing Services](https://musicianshearingservices.co.uk/what-we-do/hearing-protection/motorcycle-earplugs): Custom motorcycle earplugs with Bluetooth in-ear communicators.
